label: Martin Schmeitzel on the 1720 Augsburg genealogical-heraldic calendar

features.value: Schmeitzel praises the approximately thirty coats of arms as cleanly engraved but says the accompanying explanation is worthless

sources.citation: Martin Schmeitzel, Einleitung zur Wappen-Lehre (Jena: Johann Bernhard Hartung, 1723), p.69; wording currently checked through heraldik-wiki transcription and bibliographic copies
sources.note: The 1723 book and collation are independently attested; the exact p.69 sentence has not yet been rechecked against a page image in this sweep.

notes: High-value contemporary distinction between graphic execution and the reliability/value of heraldic explanation. Preserve below verified_primary until the 1723 page image is directly inspected.

label: Johann Ehrenfried Zschackwitz, Historisch-Genealogischer Schau-Platz

features.value: genealogies presented as purged of fables; necessary documents supplied for illumination of history and public law
authors and tables judged through accuracy, errors, certainty, trustworthiness and comparison

despite claimed worldwide correspondence, Hübner's genealogical tables contain conspicuous errors; Zschackwitz argues that tables should contain only genealogical origins about which one can speak with certainty
the work incorporates corrections and supplements sent in by another learned person to Hübner's Palatine tables
Zschackwitz states that genealogy cannot be learned without the assistance of history and therefore requires attention especially to German imperial history
Halle is credited with first putting German Reichshistorie into proper order and removing unnecessary material; Ludewig and Gundling are singled out as leading programme-builders

Gladov's Reichshistorie receives qualified praise for organization but is criticized as visibly composite, gathered from different discourses, and burdened by many printing errors and false principles
Hahn's Reichshistorie is praised as exceptionally strong, especially for understanding the necessity of allegata and supporting the work with passages and testimonies drawn from source fountains

The earlier Gladov-Hahn priority/plagiarism dispute is reframed in 1724 as an evaluative hierarchy based on compositional coherence, principles, citations and source control rather than repeated as a plagiarism charge

sources.citation: Johann Ehrenfried Zschackwitz, Historisch-Genealogischer Schau-Platz (1724), Herzog August Bibliothek digital transcription, esp. transcript lines 579-600 / anchors ID00038-ID00041

notes: Strong contemporaneous methodological control for the 1724-26 calendar transition. In addition to genealogical purification, documentary support, error correction, comparison and certainty, the body text explicitly makes genealogy dependent on Reichshistorie and ranks recent Reichshistorie works. Gladov is treated as partly well arranged but composite/error-prone; Hahn is a positive source-critical counter-model. This is primary institutional transcription control; page-image verification remains useful for diplomatic quotation and typography. No direct production/personnel relation to Weigel or Köhler has yet been located.
